using CUDA, JSON3
CUDA.allowscalar(false)

function tm(f, n)
    f(); CUDA.synchronize()
    t0 = time(); for _ in 1:n; f(); end; CUDA.synchronize()
    return (time() - t0) / n * 1e6
end

# device bytes allocated by one call
function devalloc(f)
    f(); CUDA.synchronize()
    try
        return Int(CUDA.@allocated begin; f(); CUDA.synchronize(); end)
    catch e
        return -1
    end
end

function measure(n)
    a = CUDA.CuArray(rand(n)); b = CUDA.CuArray(rand(n))
    va = view(a, 1:n); vb = view(b, 1:n)
    out = Dict{String,Any}()
    forms = (
      ("mapreduce_bare", () -> mapreduce(*, +, a, b)),
      ("mapreduce_view", () -> mapreduce(*, +, va, vb)),
      ("sum_broadcast",  () -> sum(a .* b)),
      ("sum_abs2",       () -> sum(abs2, a)),
      ("sum_plain",      () -> sum(a)),
      ("full_copy_to_host", () -> Array(a)),
    )
    for (nm, f) in forms
        try
            out[nm * "_us"]    = round(tm(f, 200), digits = 2)
            out[nm * "_bytes"] = devalloc(f)
        catch e
            out[nm * "_err"] = first(sprint(showerror, e), 100)
        end
    end
    out["array_bytes"] = n * 8
    return out
end

function main()
    r = Dict{String,Any}("device" => CUDA.name(CUDA.device()),
                         "allowscalar" => "false")
    r["n_16"]      = measure(16)
    r["n_1000000"] = measure(1_000_000)
    println(JSON3.write(r))
end
main()
